## Selected work

::: {.selected-grid}
::: {.selected-card}
[![](images/System_Architecture.png){.selected-thumb fig-alt="System model for the NOMA-ISCC vehicular network"}](research.qmd)

<p class="selected-meta">IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing · 2026</p>

### Keeping safety-critical information fresh in vehicular networks

A computation-aware NOMA-ISCC framework that jointly optimizes task scheduling, beamforming, and power allocation — so that processed sensing information reaches vehicles while it is still useful, under stringent latency constraints.

[Read more →](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.selected-card}
[![](images/IntercellInterference1.jpg){.selected-thumb fig-alt="Cell-edge multicast groups facing inter-cell interference in a multi-cell NOMA network"}](research.qmd)

<p class="selected-meta">IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications · 2024</p>

### Larger multicast groups cut interference — at the cost of freshness

Shows how multicast group size trades off against inter-cell interference and information freshness in multi-cell NOMA, and proposes AIM, which adapts group size, scheduling, and power allocation together.

[Read more →](research.qmd)
:::
:::
